players.bio: Arnel Jakupović (born 29 May 1998) is an Austrian footballer of Bosnian descent who plays as a forward for Empoli in Serie A.
Douglas Renato de Jesus (born 9 March 1983 in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo), known simply as Douglas, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays for Portuguese club Vitória S.C. as a goalkeeper.

João Miguel Coimbra Aurélio (born 17 August 1988) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for Vitória S.C. as a midfielder. Club career Nacional Born in Beja, Aurélio began his professional career with lower league club S.C. Penalva. In the 2008–09 season, he moved straight into the Primeira Liga with Madeira's C.D.

Jubal Rocha Mendes Júnior (born 29 August 1993), simply known as Jubal, is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Portuguese club Vitória de Guimarães, on loan from F.C. Arouca, as a central defender. Club career Born in Inhumas, Goiás, Jubal began his career on Vila Nova. He made his professional debut on 13 February 2011, against Aparecidense for the Campeonato Goiano championship.

Tallo Gadji-Celi Carmel Jr. (born 21 December 1992), known as Junior Tallo or just Tallo, is an Ivorian footballer who plays as a forward for Primeira Liga side Vitória de Guimarães. Club career Youth career Chievo Born in Magbehigouepa, Ouragahio, Fromager region, Tallo is a nephew of former footballer Saint-Joseph Gadji-Celi and son of Mathieu Tallo Gadji.

Lohann Doucet (born 14 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Ligue 2 club Dunkerque, on loan from Paris FC. Born in France, he plays for the Burkina Faso national team.

Marcos André Costa Valente (born 4 February 1994) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Vitória de Guimarães. Club career Born in Penafiel, Valente had two youth spells at local club F.C. Penafiel, the last starting at the age of 14.

Nélson Miguel Castro Oliveira CvIH (European Portuguese: ; born 8 August 1991) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Primeira Liga club Vitória de Guimarães. He began his career at S.L. Benfica, making 24 appearances and scored three goals for the club, while spending most of his time out on loan.

Nélson Miguel Castro Oliveira CvIH (born 8 August 1991) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Primeira Liga club Vitória de Guimarães. He began his career at Benfica, making 24 appearances and scored three goals for the club, while spending most of his time out on loan. He represented four clubs in English football, and also played in France, Spain and Greece.

Oliwier "Oli" Zych (born 28 June 2004) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ekstraklasa club Raków Częstochowa, on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa. Zych is a product of the Aston Villa Academy, having spent time as a junior in the academies of Arka Gdynia and Zagłębie Lubin in his native Poland.

Cristopher Paolo César Hurtado Huertas (born 27 July 1990), commonly known as Paolo Hurtado, is a Peruvian professional footballer who plays for Vitória S.C., as a winger. Club career Alianza Lima Hurtado made his first team debut with Alianza Lima on 17 February 2008. Knowing he would not have much opportunities in Alianza he decide to go out on loan to Juan Aurich.
Rafael Miranda da Conceição or simply Rafael Miranda (born August 11, 1984 in Belo Horizonte), is a Brazilian defensive midfielder, who currently plays for Vitória S.C..
Fábio Samuel Amorim Silva (born 21 April 1996), known as Samu, is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Vitória de Guimarães.
Telmo Emanuel Gomes Arcanjo (born 21 June 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Vitória S.C. Born in Portugal, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Toni Borevković (born 18 June 1997) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays for Portuguese club Vitória SC as a centre-back.

Tony Strata (born 7 September 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Primeira Liga club Vitória Guimarães. Born in France, he represents Romania at under-21 level. Born in France, Strata made his debut for Ajaccio on 21 May 2023, in a 5–0 Ligue 1 loss to Rennes. On 21 August 2023, he played his first match in Ligue 2 against Bordeaux.

Úmaro Embaló (born 6 May 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Portuguese Primeira Liga club Vitória de Guimarães on loan from the Dutch club Fortuna Sittard. Born in Guinea-Bissau, he was a youth international for Cuba.
Gabriel Victor David Gonçalves Andersson (born 22 October 2004) is a Swedish footballer who plays as a winger or central midfielder for AIK in Allsvenskan.
